summary: Bain Capital Private Credit filed an 8-K (Items 7.01 and 8.01) on April 29, 2026, disclosing a monthly distribution of $0.1875 per Class I share, payable May 29, 2026, to holders of record April 30, 2026, with optional reinvestment. It also reported net asset value per share of $25.83 as of March 31, 2026, aggregate NAV of $1,005.8M, portfolio fair value of $1,815.1M across 164 companies, and debt outstanding of $1,048.0M (1.04x debt/equity). This is a routine periodic update with no special-situation event. No transaction, tender, activist, restructuring, or strategic review is present.
